metadata.description: Information about the processing of personal data on the Diab Gebäudereinigung website.

PrivacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPage.introduction: This privacy policy explains which personal data may be processed when you visit this website or contact us directly by email or telephone.

controller.title: 1. Data Controller
controller.description: The controller within the meaning of the General Data Protection Regulation is:

general.title: 2. General Information on Data Processing
general.description: Personal data is processed only to the extent necessary to provide the website, respond to enquiries or fulfil legal obligations.
general.legalBasis: The applicable legal basis depends on the purpose of the processing and is described in the following sections.

hosting.title: 3. Hosting and Server Log Files
hosting.description: When you visit the website, the hosting provider may process technically necessary data, including the IP address, date and time of access, requested resource, amount of data transferred, referrer, browser and operating system.
hosting.purpose: The processing serves the secure and technically stable provision of the website as well as error detection and abuse prevention.
hosting.retention: Server log files are retained only for as long as necessary for the secure and stable operation of the website or to comply with legal obligations.
hosting.legalBasis: The processing is based on our legitimate interest in providing a secure and functional website pursuant to Article 6(1)(f) GDPR.

contact.title: 4. Contact by Email or Telephone
contact.description: If you contact us by email or telephone, we process the information you provide solely to handle your enquiry.
contact.data: Depending on the contact method, this may include your name, email address, telephone number and the content of your message.
contact.legalBasis: Processing is carried out pursuant to Article 6(1)(b) GDPR for contractual or pre-contractual enquiries, or pursuant to Article 6(1)(f) GDPR for other enquiries.
contact.retention: The data is deleted once it is no longer required to process the enquiry, unless statutory retention obligations apply.

maps.title: 5. Google Maps
maps.externalLink: This website does not automatically load an embedded Google Maps map. Only an external link to Google Maps is provided.
maps.externalEffect: When you click the link, you leave this website and Google may then process data according to its own policies.

fonts.title: 6. Fonts
fonts.description: Fonts integrated using next/font are provided locally during the build process and are not loaded directly from Google servers when visiting the website.

cookies.title: 7. Cookies and Access to End Devices
cookies.description: The current version of the website does not use analytics or marketing cookies.
cookies.necessary: Technically necessary storage or access may be used where required for the operation and security of the website.

recipients.title: 8. Recipients and Processors
recipients.description: Personal data is disclosed only where necessary to operate the website or handle direct contact.
recipients.hosting: Vercel Inc. for hosting and technical delivery of the website.
recipients.email: The relevant email provider when you contact us directly by email.

transfers.title: 9. Transfers to Third Countries
transfers.description: When Vercel is used, processing of personal data outside the European Economic Area, particularly in the United States, cannot be ruled out. Where required, transfers are based on appropriate safeguards under Articles 44 et seq. GDPR.

rights.title: 10. Rights of Data Subjects
rights.description: Subject to the legal requirements, you have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict processing, data portability and object to processing.
rights.consent: Where processing is based on consent, that consent may be withdrawn at any time with effect for the future.

complaint.title: 11. Right to Lodge a Complaint
complaint.description: You have the right to lodge a complaint with a competent data protection supervisory authority.

security.title: 12. Data Security
security.description: The website is provided through an encrypted HTTPS connection. We implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect personal data.

updates.title: 13. Updates to this Privacy Policy
updates.description: This privacy policy will be updated whenever website functions, service providers, legal bases or processing activities change.
